title: Design Uber Ride Sharing
description: Model riders, drivers, rides, matching, and ride states.

data.text: Design a ride-sharing system like Uber. Riders request rides, drivers accept, the system matches them, and tracks ride status from requested to completed.

data.title: Ride, Rider, and Driver
Matching Strategy
data.text: Simple matching uses nearest driver. Advanced matching uses ETA, driver rating, and surge pricing. Keep matching logic separate from Ride so you can swap algorithms.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: RideStatus enum encodes the ride lifecycle
Rider and Driver are separate aggregates
Matching is a service that finds the closest available driver
Fare calculation can use distance, time, and surge
data.takeaway: Ride-sharing is a matching and state-tracking problem. Ride is the central aggregate. Matching, pricing, and notifications are separate services.
